    matchLabels:
      app: productcatalogservice

      labels:
        app: productcatalogservice

      serviceAccountName: productcatalogservice

        fsGroup: 1000

      - name: server

        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
